label: Tanec · Waacking
desc: Teatrální pohled, švihy paží nad hlavou, dramatická póza, rolování trupu, freeze.
desc_en: A theatrical gaze, arm whips overhead, a dramatic pose, a torso roll, a freeze.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, graceful and dynamic motion, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: a dancer in a 1970s disco outfit stands tall, staring with an intense theatrical gaze into the camera
they whip their arms in fast, sharp overhead circles, moving wrist-over-wrist around their shoulders
they strike a dramatic pose, pressing one hand to their chest while thrusting the other arm outward
they roll their torso fluidly, moving their arms in intricate framing patterns around their neck
they end with a sudden freeze, holding a fierce head-tilt pose with one arm pointing at the viewer
